memberships.title: Natural Uncertainty Handling
memberships.general_rule: Ambiguous, underspecified, or perception-dependent requests should ask about the real uncertainty instead of leaking generic missing-skill or internal-policy speech.
memberships.rationale: A fully scoped weather request treats the unknown result as fresh Evidence rather than a user-resolvable gap.

memberships.title: Tool And Conversation Lane Discipline
memberships.general_rule: Conversation, memory, tool use, and body action should stay in the right lane, with validated arguments before any tool or skill claim.
memberships.rationale: The exact reported weather turn is fully bound at GI and requires a trusted lookup rather than clarification.

memberships.title: Planner and Goal Semantic Quality
memberships.general_rule: Goal Interpretation must preserve WHAT, Goal Association must preserve continuity only, and Planner must choose HOW from current context without inventing capabilities, collapsing independent outcomes, or converting evidence needs into user ambiguity.
memberships.rationale: Unknown weather truth is an evidence need, not a fabricated user clarification.
